theorems.statement: For every even N, the exact sequence 0 -> C2 -> C_(2N) -> C_N -> 0 induced by the root cover is non-split. Equivalently, no globally multiplicative single-valued square-root selector exists on mu_N.
theorems.proof_certificate: Any lift of the generator 1 mod N is 1 or N+1 mod 2N; both have order 2N when N is even, so neither can be the image of an element of order N under a homomorphic section.

theorems.statement: Each z in mu_N has root fiber {w,-w} in mu_(2N). A directed path plus an initial branch selects a lift; an unoriented static state does not.
theorems.boundary: This rotation-root fiber is not identified with the existing path-valued vector-norm square-root fiber, although the typing pattern is compatible.

theorems.statement: For a cycle successor S and a conjugate character mode with eigenvalue z=c+J*s, S decomposes exactly as (S+S^-1)/2 + J*(S-S^-1)/(2J). On the real two-dimensional mode, S has matrix [[c,-s],[s,c]] and J^2=-I.
For the selected mode phi, D=(S-S^-1)/(2s) and L=(S+S^-1-2I)/(2(1-c)) satisfy D phi=J phi and L phi=-phi at every finite refinement level.
theorems.interpretation: The continuous equations f'=if and f''=-f are limits of exact finite rotation-mode eigen-equations rather than the source of the finite law.

theorems.statement: After analytic completion, R -> U(1) identifies winding histories differing by a full deck period 2*pi_rot. The exponential is therefore a quotient from accumulated directed rotation history to current orientation, and Euler's identity is the half-period endpoint.
theorems.boundary: This is a typed geometric interpretation of the standard universal cover; no historical novelty is claimed for the topology itself.
